While [[Unidentified Amaran bursa dealer|another]] [[Amaran/Legends|Amaran]] negotiated the sale of a creature known as a [[Bursa/Legends|bursa]] with an interested [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] [[Unidentified Pacithhip bursa buyer|buyer]], an '''Amaran child''' prostrated between the legs of the bursa in question and talked with a [[Unidentified Veknoid (Coruscant)|Veknoid]]. The younger Amaran had [[Color/Legends|orange]] fur and wore a green, sleeveless shirt at the [[Time/Legends|time]].
